reference_sql:
WITH be14_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n_lines - 1) / SUM(n_lines), 3) AS pct_copies
FROM be14_sets
alternatives:
WITH be14_lines AS (  -- one row per BE-14 order line, as stored
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (  -- one row per different line
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM be14_lines
  ) AS unique_lines)) / COUNT(*), 3) AS pct_copies
FROM be14_lines
